# Facebook Games Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/facebook-games-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-games-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.337**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape and download Facebook Games names and live streams; followers count, concurrent viewer count, URL, and more. Get data from Facebook Games simply using one search query. Export scraped data, run the scraper via API, schedule and monitor runs, or integrate with other tools.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Result $0.0062 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-games-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-facebook-games-scraper@0.0.337#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataType` | string |  | `"games"` | 📜 Gaming section — Select section to scrape from |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | ✍️ Number of games or live streams — Select the number of games you want to scrape. |
| `searchTerm` | string |  |  | GAMES Search query — The scraper will extract games data found by this keyword |

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `facebookUrl` | string \| null | URL of the Facebook Gaming page that was scraped. |
| `id` | string \| null | Facebook ID of the game. |
| `name` | string \| null | Name of the game. |
| `url` | string \| null | URL of the game's Facebook Gaming page. |
| `cvc` | number \| null | Current concurrent viewer count for the game. |
| `follower_count` | number \| null | Number of followers of the game page. |
| `__typename` | string \| null | GraphQL type name of the returned object. |
| `cover_image` | object \| null | Cover image of the game. |
| `profile_picture` | object \| null | Profile picture of the game. |
| `display_name` | string \| null | Display name of the game. |
